note: URL counts from the sitemap index. 45001/10001 are the site's own per-file caps -- treat those as FLOORS, not censuses.
rate_limit: pace >=5s; ~50-60 sequential list pages at 1.5s -> HTTP 403 for the IP. 403 is BACK-OFF, never an empty result.

routes.articles_list: /en/articles/pageN (40 tiles/page, 82 pages; titles live in the /en/articles/<id> ANCHOR, there are ZERO <h3> tags)
routes.forum_section_list: /en/forum/<section>/pageN (30 threads/page; div.widgetRow carries title + preview + <span title="Replies">)
routes.forum_thread: /en/forum/<id>[/pageN] (div.comment-box per post; quoted parent text is inline, so reply chains are readable without extra fetches)
